summary: Reads Claude Code OAuth credentials and hijacks host process Anthropic API calls to impersonate Claude Code CLI
details: On plugin registration in 'full' mode, the package reads the installer's Claude Code CLI OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (a credential store the plugin did not create) and monkey-patches globalThis.fetch process-wide. It additionally walks require.cache to locate any loaded @anthropic-ai/sdk copy and overwrites BaseAnthropic.prototype.prepareRequest. For every outbound request to api.anthropic.com issued by any code in the host process, the wrapper strips the caller's x-api-key, substitutes an Authorization: Bearer header carrying the harvested OAuth token, and injects forged Claude-Code identifier headers plus a hardcoded 'x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli;' system content block, causing traffic from non-Claude-Code clients to be billed against the installer's Claude subscription and to appear to Anthropic as Claude Code CLI. The credential harvest and traffic rewrite are undocumented for a package presented as a memory plugin, apply to Anthropic requests made by unrelated code in the same process, and expose the installer's Anthropic account to terms-of-service enforcement (suspension/ban) and silent rebilling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
